_comment: The permission allowlist the routines need to run unattended. Merged into the
user's own ~/.claude/settings.json by scripts/install-permissions.py, which never
overwrites: it adds what is missing and leaves everything else alone.
defaultMode 'dontAsk' means no approval prompt interrupts a 6am run. The trade is
that anything NOT listed here is DENIED SILENTLY and the run carries on having lost
that step. That is exactly why routine-audit is not optional: it is the only thing
Deliberately absent: rm, git push, anything that sends mail, and any write outside
the three directories below. Those still prompt, which is correct.
